templates.text: Hi, is this {NAME}? We met at the conference last spring. Wait, this is not {NAME}? I am so sorry! You seem lovely though. What do you do for a living?

Sorry, wrong number! I was trying to reach {NAME} about our meeting on {DAY} and my assistant gave me the wrong contact. Since we are talking anyway, do you invest at all? My mentor runs a small trading group and the returns have been amazing.
{NAME}, are we still on for {DAY}? Oh no, wrong person, my apologies! You have a kind way of texting. I earn steady money trading crypto with a private group, happy to show you how it works.
Oops, I think I have the wrong number. Sorry to bother you! You seem like a good person though. My friend taught me a way to make ${AMT} a month from my phone, want me to share it?
Is this {NAME} from the golf club? No? Wrong number, sorry! I was just telling my friend how my investment advisor doubled my money this year. Do you ever invest?

My apologies, wrong number. I meant to text my business partner about a shipment. You sound successful yourself. Have you ever tried crypto trading? I can introduce you to my analyst, she helped me earn ${AMT} last quarter.
RELIEF ALERT: Families in {STATE} lost everything in the storm. Donate ${AMT} now to the National Relief Fund at {URL} — every hour counts.
{NAME}, veterans in {STATE} are sleeping outside tonight. Heroes Relief Alliance is matching every gift today only. Give by gift card or at {URL} before midnight.
A family in {COUNTY} lost their home in a fire on {DAY}. We are raising ${AMT} for rent, clothes and food. Please give what you can at {URL} and share this with everyone you know.
URGENT: Disaster victims need clean water and shelter. Your ${AMT} gift provides a week of supplies for one child. Donate by wire or crypto at {URL} — relief teams are waiting.
This is the {COUNTY} Community Relief Fund. Aid for flood households is now being distributed. Confirm your household's relief payment of ${AMT} at {URL} today before the funds run out.
USPS: Your package could not be delivered because the address on file is incomplete. Update your address within 12 hours or the parcel will be returned to the sender: {URL}
FedEx: An international parcel addressed to you is being held at customs. A clearance fee of ${FEE} must be paid before it can be released. Pay securely at {URL}
UPS: The name on your package does not match the name on your ID. Confirm your details at {URL} within 24 hours to avoid storage fees of ${FEE} per day.
Delivery notice from the {COUNTY} distribution center: your parcel is waiting for pickup. Verify your phone number and pay the ${FEE} processing charge to release it: {URL} Case {BADGE}.
DHL: Your shipment was stopped at the regional facility because the recipient address cannot be verified. Correct it now at {URL} or the shipment is destroyed on {DAY}.

meta.purpose: Scam Shield v9 seed templates. wrong_number_opener is a NEW TRAINING family: wrong-number conversational openers that pivot to a crypto / mentor / investment pitch (v4's known deliberate gap — its wrong_number held-out template scored 0/12 in v4-v8 and was left untuned). charity_relief + package_delivery are NEW EXAM families: excluded from ALL v9 training and validation; the v9 held-out exam is generated from all their templates. charity_relief appears nowhere in any prior round (verified against PROVENANCE.md, seeds_v4.json, seeds_v8.json and all gen/train scripts). package_delivery is new as a seed-template family; DISCLOSED: delivery register is partially seen via v5's transactional package templates and IMC25's delivery scam_type, so the exam is 'new family, partially seen register'. Seeds come ONLY from US-government publications (FTC consumer alerts/articles, FBI IC3 PSAs, FinCEN alerts, U.S. Postal Inspection Service) read 2026-11-18, or are faithful templates of the exact script mechanics those publications describe. Slot placeholders like {AMT}, {FEE}, {URL} are filled ONLY by deterministic code in augment_v4.py (fixed lists, fictional 555 numbers, code-generated lookalike URLs). No LLM wrote any seed text; no social-media posts were used as data.

charity_relief: FTC Consumer Advice, 'When donating, support those in need, not a scammer' (consumer.ftc.gov, 2026) — fake charities and impersonated well-known charities after disasters; pressure to give; payment only by gift card, wire or cryptocurrency is a red flag
FTC, 'Charity Scams After a Disaster' (ftc.gov) — charities that spring up overnight after a tragedy; confirm text-to-donate numbers on the charity's own site
FTC charity guidance, ftc.gov/charity — donate wisely, avoid charity scams; crowdfunding and social-media appeals
package_delivery: FTC Consumer Alert, 'Think that text message is from USPS? It could be a scam' (2025-04-23), consumer.ftc.gov — fake USPS delivery-problem texts with links; real USPS will not demand payment to redeliver a package

FTC Data Spotlight / press release, 'New FTC Data Show Top Text Message Scams of 2024' (Apr 2025) — fake package-delivery problems were the most commonly reported text scam of 2024; small 'redelivery fee' used to harvest card details

U.S. Postal Inspection Service, 'Smishing: Package Tracking Text Scams' (uspis.gov) — USPS texts only when the customer requested tracking with a tracking number, never contain a link, never demand a fee
wrong_number_opener: FTC Consumer Alert, 'When are you free for coffee? Long lost friend or a scammer trying to get you to respond' (2024-08-05), consumer.ftc.gov — wrong-number / long-lost-friend opener turning into a crypto pitch (already v4 source #10)
FinCEN Alert on pig-butchering / crypto investment fraud (Sep 2023) — initial contact often a wrong-number text; grooming into crypto investment with a mentor/analyst figure
FBI IC3 PSA I-120324-PSA (2024-12-03), 'Criminals Use Generative Artificial Intelligence to Facilitate Financial Fraud' — impersonation and false-identity contact leading to money demands

meta.split_rule: For the TRAINING family (wrong_number_opener): per family, template index 1 is validation-only and index 3 is internal-test-only; all other templates are train (same rule as seeds_v4.json / seeds_v8.json). For the EXAM families (charity_relief, package_delivery): NO template is train or validation; all templates generate exam rows only.
